findings.description: From about 00:02.25 to 00:04.0 the object in the real hand, pressed into the hair above the ear, appears as a dark comb-like shape. In the mirror at the same moments, the hand holds a bright white/pale bar on the forehead. Before (00:01.75) and after (00:04.25) this stretch, both views show the same pale slim tool. During the stretch the object seems to change identity or appearance with no visible swap.

At 00:08.75-00:09.0 the real right hand's fingers pinch at the jaw with no tool visible, while the mirror clearly shows the tool held against the cheek. At 00:09.25 the tool reappears in the real hand, held upright. This could be occlusion behind the fingers or jaw, but the tool is missing on the real side for at least one frame.

For most of the clip the tool reads as a white/pale slim bar. At 00:09.25-00:09.75 it reads as a clearly metallic silver straight razor with a visible blade and handle, in both views. Nothing visible accounts for the change in appearance. This may be lighting or motion blur on the same object.
